description: Canonical embedding runs selected for downstream experiments. Paths are relative to the repository root.
selection_policy: Use only complete runs with embeddings.npy and qids.json. Audio runs must also have audio_manifest.tsv.
notes: BirdNET is currently being regenerated with another model/run and is intentionally excluded from runs.audio for now.
wav2vec2 fine-tuned embedding runs are still being generated and should be moved from pending_runs to runs.audio only after embeddings.npy, qids.json, audio_manifest.tsv, and metadata.json exist.
Experiment code should prefer this file over auto-discovery when present.
